effectsSummary: 感知和感受变得更强烈。从 10-15 mg（鼻吸从 5 mg 起）可能出现视幻觉，如明亮色彩、几何图案、图像扭曲。20-25 mg 时幻觉加剧，可能体验到自我消解。超过 25 mg 通常导致完全丧失自我。
dosageRemark: [TBT] 2C-I is effective even in small doses; even 2 mg more or less can make a big difference in the effect experienced; a gradual approach to the individual dose is recommended. Doses above 35 mg can be experienced as unpleasantly strong even by experienced users.
generalRisks: 瞳孔放大，血压升高，可能出现恶心、出汗和头晕。体温升高；必须避免过热。
longtermRisks: [TBT] There are no research results on long-term risks so far.
saferUse: 2C-I 似乎高度依赖于环境，仅在一定程度上适合派对场合。
